slides.texte_overlay:
5 daily habits that will
improve your life

1. Walk 10 minutes after dinner
It helps digestion
and clears your head
before the evening.

2. Call someone you care about
One real voice a day
beats a hundred likes.

3. Write one sentence
about your day
In a year, you'll have
a book about your life.

4. Take the stairs
Small effort, every day.
It adds up faster
than you think.

5. Learn one new thing
A fact, an idea, a story.
A curious mind
never gets dull.
slides.texte_sophia:
5. Learn one new thing
Use a micro-learning app
like the Sophia app:
history, science or art
in 5 minutes.
